name: Thresher-Plated Colossus

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The thresher-plated colossus makes two Gore attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Opportunist's Lash.

Actions.name: Gore
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the thresher-plated colossus moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Plated Slam (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 49 (14d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

Actions.name: Opportunist's Lash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Prone. *Failure:* 35 (10d6) Piercing damage. *Success:* Half damage.
Actions.gmQuote: knocks everything flat and keeps going

Bonus Actions.name: Trample
Bonus Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Traits.name: Relentless Charge
Traits.text: While the thresher-plated colossus is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the thresher-plated colossus's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.
Traits.expressedQuote: the thresher-plated colossus's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement

lore: Grown from the shed hide-plates of a dead colossus, a thresher-beast patrols a single ancient path and exists only to flatten whatever dares stand upon it.

generation.userConcept: a thresher-beast that charges in a straight line, knocks everything flat, and keeps going
generation.cite: composition after Gorgon (CR 5) — charge plus a breath-shaped nova
